final_sha_scope: Implementation, research, and audit documentation tip immediately before this acceptance ledger commit; final branch tip is reported separately.

bugs_confirmed.finding: Anonymous visitors share plans, provider declines, and approvals in the process SQLite sandbox.
The shared 20 requests / 60 seconds budget interrupts concurrent valid workflows.
Public errors could show local developer instructions; 429 copy and browser-readable Retry-After were missing.
Old scenario results remained visible during and after a failed recalculation.
A demo provider decline could not be restored from the public UI.
Plan retry refreshed history but not a failed selected plan detail.
Boundary middleware short-circuited 429 before CORS, hiding the response and retry hint from cross-origin clients.

bugs_fixed: Q-03 public-safe error guidance, top-level error code parsing, Retry-After hint, and CORS exposure
Q-04 clear stale comparison data and disable inputs during calculation
Q-05 restore a synthetic provider round to AVAILABLE
Q-06 reload selected plan state on manual retry
Q-12 CORS wraps the boundary middleware; integration test covers cross-origin 429

bugs_deferred.reason: Kept shared synthetic sandbox with an explicit notice. Anonymous visitor isolation needs a reviewed session, CSRF, namespace, cleanup, and persistence design.
Retained the abuse ceiling; per-session fairness cannot safely rely on client-controlled identity.
Real demand, benefit, provider participation, savings, and authenticated approvals were not tested.

multi_visitor.decision: D — shared synthetic sandbox with explicit visitor-sharing and restart notice
multi_visitor.evidence: Three isolated browser contexts reproduced A create, B read/replan, A decline, C create/approve, and A observe approval. Stale schedule ID returned 404. Restart invalidation passed against temporary SQLite.
multi_visitor.pii: Only the synthetic fixture was used; existing public-demo PII scan and blocked private-route checks remained in the backend suite.
limitations: Anonymous visitors can modify each other's synthetic plans until backend restart.
A visit-link identifier is not authentication or ownership.

rate_limit.policy: 20 limited requests / 60 seconds shared process bucket
rate_limit.retry_after: Returned on 429, exposed through public CORS, displayed as a manual wait hint; no automatic retry.

network_recovery.evidence: Local E2E mocks covered 403, 404, 409, 422, 429, 500, 503, timeout/network abort, and transient plan-detail 503 recovery. One read-only GET to the public frontend and one to API health returned 200 in about 32.68 seconds each.
limitations: No forced sleep/restart or repeated remote checks.
The two remote observations do not establish a cold-start latency distribution.

user_journey.evidence: Local public-demo flow covered dashboard, evidence and policy comparison, provider decline/restore, replan, plan approval simulation, memo, and CSV export. Shared context changes and stale IDs were verified.
limitations: Full browser journey was not run against public Render.
Approval is a synthetic demo simulation.

security_regression.evidence: Full backend suite and public-demo tests exercised route allowlist, private-route blocking, synthetic storage reset, security headers, CORS, shared limiter, untrusted visitor header, and PII protections.
security_regression.independent_review: NOT_VERIFIABLE; cross-provider attempts were unavailable due provider quota and worker checkout failures.

performance.evidence: Bounded local actual-API workflows recorded request latency for 1/3/5/10 visitors; p50, descriptive p95, max, and errors are in the load JSON. At 10 visitors scenario-calculation max was about 7.30 seconds.
limitations: Small request samples; p95 is descriptive only.
No separate network-vs-solver benchmark or dedicated 4-policy and memo latency distributions.
No public load test was run.

policy_robustness.scope: SYNTHETIC existing monthly aggregate comparator; BASELINE_DECOMPOSED schedule optimizer unchanged
policy_robustness.results: 36 policy-budget-seed rows (3 seeds × 3 budgets × 4 policies), 12 synthetic provider-removal rows, 4 low-data forecast-gate cases. All reference policy rows OPTIMAL; budget, capacity, supported service/provider assignment, coverage, and served-unit integrity checks passed; deterministic replay passed.
limitations: Decline sweep is aggregate recomputation, not dated replan sensitivity.
Travel-cost and historical underserved inputs are unsupported and held fixed.
No PNG plots; matplotlib is unavailable and no dependency was added.

data_integrity.evidence: Read-only lineage review classified real public data, official directories, external priors, synthetic assumptions, and unknown availability; rechecked documented HomeDoctor mismatch, provider directory count discrepancy, and incomplete full legal-code validation without rewriting raw snapshots.
limitations: No new external collection or real authority data.
Village demand, current provider availability/capacity/prices, and field outcomes remain unestablished.
The shared demo does not provide visitor isolation.
Cross-provider independent review is not verified.
Automated accessibility checks do not constitute screen-reader user validation.
Render evidence is limited to two low-frequency read-only GETs.
Policy outcomes are synthetic, not evidence of real service or budget impact.
Dedicated performance distributions and plots were not produced.
next_actions: Design and independently review visitor/session isolation before storing any private or real pilot data.
Evaluate a global safety ceiling plus server-issued bounded session fairness without trusting arbitrary headers.
Plan authenticated field validation and separate solver/network performance sampling before production claims.
